recognize_zh: 這是流程示意圖（Figure 2）：MPN 導致血栓，並分為動脈（經動脈粥狀硬化）與靜脈血栓；CHIP 同時連到動脈粥狀硬化與其他癌症，發炎與 MPN、其他癌症雙向互相促進並獨立促成血栓。
features: MPN leads to thrombosis, which branches into atherosclerosis (then arterial) and venous thrombosis
CHIP connects to atherosclerosis and to other cancers
Bidirectional arrows link MPN with other cancers and other cancers with inflammation
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic flow diagram (Figure 2) summarizing the pathogenesis of thrombosis in myeloproliferative neoplasms. MPN is shown as a direct driver of thrombosis, subdivided into venous thrombosis and atherosclerosis leading to arterial thrombosis. Clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) is linked to atherosclerosis and to other cancers, and inflammation is depicted as bidirectionally connected with cancers and as an independent contributor to thrombosis. The figure is interpreted as a conceptual model rather than diagnostic data.
